subject: look at the necks
author: drunknnumpty
body:
dude enjoy your time out in the east where girls are girls and so are the boys... maybe you'll have a story or two to tell on your return.. but if its any worse than my snowboarding one i dont want the details ;)

subject: Yuhesssssss... smutty, smutty (the smuttyest) Lady.
author: SUFFUR
body:
Shall I tell the Sailor boys and the dock hands (the world busiest port here people, might need that axel grease, let alone the KY, can i borrow Xan's stuff Zom), that you sent me and that they have to take care of me? Mostly be doing Central Route, short and long, and some reverse, with a mixture of laps.
Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

subject: World Traveller

body: Have an Awesome time Suffur! I'm looking forward to hearing about your adventures in the Far East. Will you be visiting Island Paradise and taking in the sites of Golden City, cruising on Tropical Drive and meeting the sailors by the Dockside?
